data.content_ref: inline:Reduction: SRC_014's two-level warrant validity reduces to two successive standard grounded computations, because the outer attack relation is a pure function of the inner grounded labelling and the derived graph is itself a Dung AF. Refuted if there is a graph where an argument accepted only in the outer labelling attacks a warrant, so the inner pass cannot see it and the reduced semantics misses a self-referential warrant challenge that a mutually recursive semantics would catch.
